```{r}
# =============================================================================
# TARGETED IDW INTERPOLATION FOR LEVEE REMOVAL
# =============================================================================
# Purpose: Fill structure pixels in a DEM using IDW interpolation from 
#          donut ring reference points — WITHOUT computing IDW wall-to-wall.
#
# Inputs:
#   1. DEM raster (WorldDEM Neo, 5m)
#   2. Structure mask raster (anthroporas: 1 = structure, 0 = ground)
#   3. Donut ring points (GeoPackage with VALUE column = elevation)
#
# Output:
#   DEM_corrected.tif — the DEM with structures replaced by IDW surface
# =============================================================================

# ---- 1. Load libraries ----
library(terra)   # Modern raster handling (read, write, manipulate rasters)
library(sf)      # Read vector data (.gpkg points file)
library(RANN)    # Fast nearest-neighbor search using KD-trees


# ---- 2. Set file paths ----
dem_path    <- "H:/GIS_Structure/GE_Working_Folder/03_GE_Analysis/03b_GE_Intermediate_Files/DEM_prepatation_intermediate/WorldDEMNeo_zu_5m.tif"
mask_path   <- "H:/GIS_Structure/GE_Working_Folder/03_GE_Analysis/03b_GE_Intermediate_Files/DEM_prepatation_intermediate/Mask_Structure.tif"
points_path <- "H:/GIS_Structure/GE_Working_Folder/03_GE_Analysis/03b_GE_Intermediate_Files/DEM_prepatation_intermediate/Points_for_Interpolation.gpkg"
output_path <- "H:/GIS_Structure/GE_Working_Folder/03_GE_Analysis/03b_GE_Intermediate_Files/DEM_prepatation_intermediate/DEM_corrected.tif"
```
